$$
\text{Total time used} = \frac{x + y}{1000} \text{ hours}

---

$$
\frac{x + y}{1000} \geq 110 \quad \text{(To fully utilize the 110 hours)}
$$

$$
\text{Overtime} = \frac{x + y}{1000} - 110
$$

### Constraint 2: Overtime Should Not Exceed 10 Hours

$$
